audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 with a 10/10 carry threat. The packet flags the 52.17% win rate against a Jax-heavy chart, but that is 23 games and the fix belongs in the chart rows, which the mirror already settled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were 'Skill' and 2+ items was 'Jax' — the opposite of the packet chart and of this page's own whys.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill / Jax / Jax / Jax / Jax / Jax / Skill and the mirror flipped exactly rows 3, 4 and 6. whys[3] says Counter Strike eats the trades you want at 4-5, whys[4] says his all-in at 6 is the bigger one, and whys[6] says by two items the duel evens out.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4 and 6 flipped as matched pairs in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Jax cooldown appeared anywhere, and Empower's auto reset was never flagged as the burst tell.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s — a 17-second window at rank 1 is the single biggest punish in this lane, and it dodges basic attacks only, which is why the existing advice to poke with Riptide instead of autos is right. Empower is 7/6/5/4/3s and carries the autoReset flag, so his wind-up is the step-back cue. Leap Strike is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, shorter than your 14s Dredge Line, so he re-engages before your hook returns.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the 17s, 7s and 8s numbers.

audit.why: The packet's two suspectNames ('Use Depth Charge', 'His Counter Strike') are false positives — both are the real names with a leading word attached. Nothing to change.

edits.before: Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges autos and stuns, 17s at rank 1 — bait it first.

edits.before: That is Jax's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Empower is a 7s auto reset — his wind-up, not the cast, is your step-back cue.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Leap Strike is 8s at rank 1 — he re-engages before your Q returns.

edits.before: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — dodges autos and stuns, 17s at rank 1. Bait it before you commit. - Leap Strike: an 8s re-engage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: The content layer here was already accurate on the key interaction — Counter Strike dodges basic attacks, so the page correctly tells you to poke with Riptide instead of autos. All that was missing were the numbers and the three wrong chart rows.
